column1: # Dwarf Fortress procedural-name senses and ECDICT gaps.
# Drink nouns retain the same family labels as material names.
# Generated-name noun: retain the reviewed "The Murk of Miring" wording.
# Generated-name nouns follow the reviewed PATTERN / NOUN sense.
# Generated religious offices reuse name components across arbitrary titles.
# Civilization adjectives used productively before world-site types.
# Settlement hillock(s) retain the established 丘区 definition with or without
# a race prefix. Natural terrain hill(s) remain 丘陵.
# Individual buildings (a hillock) use the scoped building vocabulary instead.
# Animal-status fallback: do not use ECDICT's "lost livestock" noun gloss.
# Reviewed STRAY noun/verb senses remain in data/runtime/procedural-word-senses.tsv.
